$description: AgentsFramework UI — dark theme color tokens (DTCG). Explicit derived tokens: the dark surfaces/borders/overlays use richer per-mode mix percentages than light (surface 92/8 vs 96/4, sunken 85/15, accent-light 22%, selected/borders bumped). Per the P0 architecture, the source only redeclares *primitives* for dark and lets derived tokens recompute; this file re-introduces the per-mode derived values explicitly so the dark look (Cocoa base + embossed/etched separation) is preserved by the build instead of being flattened to the light percentages. Derived $values are the oklab color-mix recipes resolved to sRGB; keep the recipe in $extensions for regeneration if a primitive changes.

muted.$description: Secondary text — brightened for dark legibility (frozen v11).

accent-light.$description: Accent wash for badges/hover. Per-mode: 22% in dark (vs 15% light).

border.$description: Hairline border. Per-mode: fg 14% in dark (vs 12% light).

surface.$description: Raised surface (cards, sidebar, menus). Per-mode: bg 92% / fg 8% in dark (vs 96/4 light) — preserves embossed separation on Cocoa.

surface-sunken.$description: Sunken/inset surface. Per-mode: bg 85% / fg 15% in dark (vs 92/8 light).

selected.$description: Selected/hover overlay. Per-mode: fg 10% in dark (vs 6% light).

placeholder.$description: Dark-only input placeholder — dimmed below --color-muted so empty fields still read as empty against the brightened secondary text (frozen v11 safeguard).
